item.title: Who Are We, and What Does That Mean About Politics?
item.description: When we face the question of what makes us who we are, different people have different answers. Some see ourselves as receptacles of tradition. Others see us as a self to be discovered in the world. Still others see us as blank slates who can become whatever we can dream.

item.title: The Poison of Negative Idealism
item.description: Negative idealism explains why "critical" movements like Communism, Fascism, and Woke of all types trend toward violence.

item.title: The Nazi Experiment, Vol. 12: Positive Christianity as the "Christian Nationalism" of the Third Reich
item.description: A "Christian Nationalist" movement is reaching into many legitimate anxieties of American Christians and turning them to its project.

item.description: The friend-enemy distinction is the underlying organizational principle of the Marxist Left, radical Islam, and the Fascist Reactionary Left.

item.title: The Israel Question as the Modern Jewish Question

item.title: OnlySubs: James Reads the Bible: Matthew 4:1-11
